page.overview:
Who is Scat?

Scat is a recurrent character who appears in the Cthulhu Mythos works of the late American author Michael Shea.

An intelligent, pretty young woman. Called a "nervy little minx, bright as a button," and a "bright kid, merry and invulnerable." Scat is described as looking

She is a sex worker in a more run-down part of San Francisco, and has a voracious appetite for the work of weird fiction writers like H. P. Lovecraft and Clark Ashton Smith. She describes herself as "a hooker that reads."

Scat first stumbled across the forces of the Cthulhu Mythos when she and Dee - the owner of a local bookstore which she frequented - accidentally ate cookies laced with cannabis. The ingestion of the drug brought the two to the attention of a supernatural killer in service to Dagon and, although they were able to defeat the creature, were forever changed by the encounter.
